entry.title: The Kilpatrick Dynasty — Next Generation Playbook
entry.content:
The Connection

Banks didn’t just operate in Kilpatrick’s shadow — he stepped into it deliberately.

At the 2023 Michigan CBC Party at the Grand Hyatt in Washington, DC, Banks’ honored guests included:

HonoreeTitleSignificance
Carolyn Cheeks KilpatrickFormer U.S. Congresswoman (1997–2011)Kwame Kilpatrick’s mother. Honorary host at Banks’ CBC party.
Nicole Wells-StallworthCEO, The Children’s CenterMacDowell Board Chair — hired Banks
Ric PreussIBEW Local 18Became MacDowell Board Secretary

Banks put Kwame’s mother on his flyer. At his party. In Washington. During Congressional Black Caucus Week. This is not coincidence — it’s a brand statement: I am the next generation of the Kilpatrick machine.

The Kilpatrick Family

PersonRoleFederal Record
Kwame KilpatrickFormer Mayor of Detroit (2002–2008)24 federal felony convictions — RICO, mail fraud, wire fraud, tax fraud, extortion. Sentenced to 28 years. Commuted by Trump (Jan 2021).
Carolyn Cheeks KilpatrickFormer U.S. Congresswoman (MI-13/15), 1997–2011Lost 2010 primary to Hansen Clarke — voters punished her for Kwame’s crimes. Died Oct 7, 2025.
Bernard KilpatrickKwame’s fatherConvicted of filing false tax returns related to Kilpatrick Enterprise proceeds

The Kilpatrick Network Nodes in Banks’ Orbit

1. Karen Dumas — From Kwame’s Comms Chief to Banks’ PR

FieldValue
CompanyImages & Ideas, Inc. (LARA #444077, est. 1991)
Under KwameExecutive Director of Community Relations, Mayor Kilpatrick’s office
Under BingChief of Communications, Mayor Bing
Banks connectionFacebook support for PCA. Social circle overlap. Banks thanks her by name in his book.
CurrentCommunications consultant, Detroit

Karen Dumas went from managing Kwame Kilpatrick’s public image to promoting Brian Banks’ charter school on social media. The job description didn’t change — protect a convicted public official’s reputation — only the client did.

On Kwame’s commutation: “I have long felt that 28 years was just too long. I was glad to see that Donald Trump commuted his sentence.” — Karen Dumas, WDET, Jan 2021

2. Kenneth Daniels — From Kwame Appointee to Dark Money Operator ✅ Verified

FieldValueSource
Former officeMichigan State Rep, District 5 (1999–2004)Ballotpedia
Kwame appointmentDetroit Water & Sewerage Dept BoardDetroit Free Press, Sep 18, 2014
Detroit Board of EdElected member (3 years)Free Press

Sentence1 year federal prison (Sep 2014)Free Press

Powell operation$21 million laundered, 12 kg cocaine, 30 kg heroin, 1,000 lbs marijuanaDEA
Powell sentenceLIFE (both brothers, Oct 2014)Free Press, Oct 17, 2014
2010 Senate raceLost to Bert Johnson — the same seat Banks tried to run for. Johnson later indicted for ghost employeesPublic record

The Structuring Pattern

Keith Stallworth (2003): Structured $20,000 through Michigan National Bank to hide drug money. Kenneth Daniels (2014): Structured $19,000 through two banks to buy a drug kingpin a Mercedes.

Different decades. Same crime. Same method. Same network.

Both were former state representatives. Both structured ~$20K for drug operations. Both got minimal sentences. Both remained active in Detroit politics. Both are connected to Brian Banks.

3. Charles Pugh — From Council President to Convicted Sex Offender ✅ Verified

FieldValue
Former officeDetroit City Council President (2009–2013)
Banks connectionReferred Tramaine Cotton to Banks as legislative aide (2013)
Banks settlementState of Michigan paid Cotton ~$12,000 + $85,622 to Dickinson Wright
Criminal convictionCriminal sexual conduct with a minor

Pugh referred Cotton to Banks. Cotton alleged Banks pressured him into sex acts. The state settled. Pugh was later convicted of CSC with a minor. Banks’ referral network runs through convicted sex offenders.

4. Sherry Gay-Dagnogo — From Kwame Clemency to Banks Defense ✅ Verified

FieldValue
CurrentDetroit Ombudsman (10-year term to 2035)
FormerDPSCD Board Member — authorized PCA’s charter
2016Publicly rallied for Banks when AG filed felony charges: “These attacks will not be tolerated”
2017Defended Banks’ plea deal: “For him to have charges for a loan that was paid back is disheartening”
2020Sought Kwame Kilpatrick clemency from Trump at White House

Gay-Dagnogo defended Kwame’s crimes. Then she defended Banks’ crimes. Then she authorized Banks’ charter school. Then she got a 10-year appointment as Detroit Ombudsman — the office that’s supposed to hold city institutions accountable.

The Pattern

KWAME KILPATRICK (24 federal felonies, RICO, pardoned)
│
├── CAROLYN CHEEKS KILPATRICK (mother)
│   └── Honorary host at Banks' 2023 CBC party
│
├── KAREN DUMAS (comms chief → PR)
│   └── Manages Banks' public image via social media
│       Banks thanks her BY NAME in his book
│
├── KENNETH DANIELS (Kwame appointee → drug money structurer)
│   ├── Structured $19K for drug kingpin Carlos Powell
│   ├── Now officer of Detroit Leaders (dark money)
│   └── Detroit Leaders supported Latisha Johnson (PCA Board Secretary)
│       Johnson defeated ML Elrick — the journalist investigating Banks
│
├── CHARLES PUGH (Council President → sex offender)
│   └── Referred Cotton to Banks → sexual harassment → state settlement
│
└── SHERRY GAY-DAGNOGO (Kwame defender → Banks defender → Ombudsman)
    ├── Sought Kwame clemency from Trump (2020)
    ├── Rallied for Banks at AG charges (2016)
    ├── Authorized PCA charter (2025)
    └── Now Ombudsman (10yr term to 2035) — the "accountability" office

Four Dynasties, One Machine

DynastyPatriarch/OriginFederal RecordPipeline to Banks
KilpatrickKwame (Mayor)24 felonies, RICO, pardonedMom at CBC party → Dumas PR → Daniels dark money → Gay-Dagnogo charter authorization
StallworthAlma (State Rep)Keith: $20K gang money launderingBCF board → Nicole hires Banks → Misha authorizes charter
SabreeEric (Treasurer)FBI-probed, Bowles class action2 children on bench → foreclosure pipeline → tax auction self-dealing
Banks/FlenoryOD Banks (BMF)BMF Defendant #22Blood → Tonesa Welch (BMF figure) → enterprise professionalized

The machine survived Kwame’s conviction. It survived the BMF prosecution. It survived Keith Stallworth’s guilty plea. It survived the FBI probing the Sabrees. It put on a suit, moved into the school system, and now extracts $4.9 million in public education dollars while producing 3% math proficiency.

The same communities destroyed by the crack trade, by Kwame’s corruption, by the foreclosure pipeline — those communities’ children now sit in Banks’ classrooms, unable to do basic math, while the machine counts their heads for per-pupil funding.
